purpose: Static authoring reference for the narrow InventoryBalance SuiteQL adapter bundled with this skill. Use only when live SuiteQL metadata establishes that InventoryBalance is catalog-visible but does not enumerate properties. This reference never overrides an explicit access denial, table absence, contradictory live metadata, or SQL validation error.
source: Derived from the validated InventoryBalance field set used by the companion inventory exception templates and restricted here to fields needed for current item/location/bin balance reads.
